sloka: मन्मथ अभिपरीतस्य मम मन्मथ वर्धनाः ।पश्य लक्ष्णम नृत्यन्तम् मयूरम् उपनृत्यति ॥४-१-३८॥
transliteration: manmatha abhiparītasya mama manmatha vardhanāḥ ।paśya lakṣṇama nṛtyantam mayūram upanṛtyati ॥4-1-38॥

translations.english: 'Look at the lovelorn peahen, excited by love, dancing on the moutain slope, O Lakshmana Engrossed in love, she dances for wooing the peacock.
translations.hindi: हे हनुमन्‌! सुम्रीब ने जो तुम्हारे द्वारा हमसे कहलाया है, हम लोग तदनुसार ही करेंगे
